clips.caption:
A guard with a gun ran after them. Kevin thought he was in trouble.

Kevin Trudeau tells what happened when he turned around in a casino, sure he had done something wrong. The guard only wanted to tell him a credit was still sitting in one machine because he forgot to pull the handle.

They walked back together, he pulled it, and he passed the winnings out to his friends. His verdict on the whole story: that's luck.

What is the luckiest thing that ever happened to you?
